entire world his addiction to constant conflict his contempt for international law and his willingness to jeopardize global stability for the sake of securing personal power make him one of the most dangerous politicians of our time this is how netanyahus war becomes our war when israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu assured in the spring that the overthrow of the regime in tehran is only a matter of time the failed regime changes in iraq and libya have haunted the minds of many european diplomats jerusalems vision is still a straight line sabotage of iranian nuclear facilities assassinations of scientists sanctions as a stranglehold and ultimately the overthrow of the mullahs leadership all with the stakes placed on reza pahlavi the son of the last shah the idea seems to be that in an operation where israel performs the surgery washington is supposed to carry the patient to the intensive care unit benjamin netanyahu represents a profound threat to global stability and justice his actions have had devastating consequences not only for his own people but also for the wider global community it is no secret that his political survival has long been tied to the threat of war netanyahus strategy is as transparent and cynical as putins by portraying the country he leads as under constant siege he unites a fragmented society behind him while simultaneously suppressing dissent both at home and abroad his recourse to external enemies real or imagined helps him distract from the corruption incompetence of his government and the fragility of his farright coalition for netanyahu war is not just a tool of statecraft it is the lifeblood of his rule iranian domestic politics is defined by the concept of estebdad an authoritarian culture of control that is deeply embedded in all layers of the state and society estebdad is not limited to mosques or the barracks of the islamic revolutionary guard corps irgc but extends from village chiefs to university presidents etc in iran a change of power has historically meant the destruction of the entire old network not just a change in the makeup of the regime and that is precisely why iranians are wary of all liberators be they ayatollahs or royals israels recent enthusiasm to crown the hereditary shah reza pahlavi reveals one of the middle easts farces israeli militant prime minister netanyahu and his western partners are putting forward a man with no evidence of a political support network a democratic mandate or even a politically coherent program to solve irans problems after all the monarch card is the only card in jerusalems game in fact reza pahlavi has lived in isolation from iranian reality for four decades the degree of irony is almost carnivalesque netanyahu who has spent decades fearing the iranian nuclear threat is now bringing up the man whose father specifically initiated irans nuclear program with the blessing of the united states and europe behind the theatrical hostility and incompetent diplomacy is a bitter irony the united states played a central role in creating this also middle east crisis in the first place when it dismantled iranian democracy few people remember but before the shah before the islamic revolution before the hostage crisis of 1979 when 52 americans were held hostage for 444 days in the american embassy in tehran and before the nuclear race iran was a democracy in 1951 the prime minister the secular nationalist mohammad mossadegh was elected in a landslide in democratic elections his greatest crime was the nationalization of iranian oil which the british empire had considered the property of british petroleum bp the cia and mi6 organized operation ajax a countercoup that ousted mossadegh and restored the shah a dictator whose repressive policies sowed the seeds of the 1979 islamic revolution the united states gained a flexible ally iran gained decades of tyranny followed eventually by a clerical theocracy i repeat the very iranian nuclear program that washington has since demonized was once its own project under the shah the united states actively promoted irans atomic ambitions by supplying reactors fuel and technical expertise it was only after the revolution that the nuclear program became an existential threat once again shah mohammad reza pahlavi founded the atomic energy organization of iran in 1974 and loudly declared that both nuclear energy and nuclear weapons could be part of irans toolbox the fordcarter administrations of us presidents generously offered reactor deals and uranium reprocessing plants that iran could use to develop nuclear weapons within a few years when the islamic revolution in 1979 overthrew the shah it was the regime of ayatollah khomeini netanyahus current terror figure that halted the nuclear projects as an imperialist misadventure tehrans nuclear research only resumed after the westernbacked invasion of iraq against saddam hussein began and chemical weapons forced iran to prepare for the worst the history recounted above makes netanyahus current coronation stunt to say the least hollow it is known that israel has its own secret nuclear arsenal outside the npt which has never been sanctioned there is a lesson here when the west applauds a nuclear program it is peaceful in nature ie pursued by allies when independent nations seeking independence from the west do the same it is an apocalyptic threat the double standard is obvious but the game is at least transparent israel which possesses an undeclared nuclear arsenal and refuses to join the npt is waging war under the guise of nonproliferation a justification as empty as the bush administrations lies about iraqs weapons of mass destruction netanyahu has told trump in their meeting that an attack on iran is a necessity in selfdefense and trump is irans second target the destruction of israel is only part of a larger iranian program which is included in the shiite eschatological myth for the radical shiite consciousness the nuclear bomb has a sacred meaning and the myth is the idea of the end of the world the revolutionary leader ayatollah ruhollah khomeini used the expression in 1979 that the united states is the great devil israel is the little devil and they must be destroyed this is the condition for the return of the imam mahdi at the end of time to bring justice to the earth the main figure of the purificatory apocalyptic teaching is the 9th century 12th imam muhammad al mahdi the hidden imam whose return is predicted by global chaos war and suffering thus the end of the world is not a threat but a promise however it seems that the iranian bomb scares tel aviv less than the idea of an iran that refuses to bow to the regional hierarchy defined by israel read netanyahu and that continues to support palestine and demands its own right to selfdetermination netanyahu is therefore not afraid of an iranian bomb but of an independent iran just as north koreas nuclear deterrent has protected it from regime change wars the pahlavi monarchy card is rather an attempt to restore tehran to a nice guy and a compliant partner treating its own citizens authoritarianly who would respect the views and interests of tel aviv and washington so a puppet ruler is wanted in iran and the dictatorial shah king fits that role who once came to power in a ciabacked coup against irans democratically elected government in 1953 and ruled with an iron fist until the iranian revolution of 1979 the old and tired drama is being repeated the united states is tightening sanctions and strangling irans economy claiming that they are targeting only the regime the reality is different inflation is running at nearly 40 percent medicine shortages are killing civilians and ordinary iranians are ultimately paying for everything and what does washington expect in return gratitude submission i still remember when i was living in london during the islamic revolution of 1979 and as a budding journalist i decided to visit the building next door to earls court the iranian students dormitory to conduct interviews i thought it was a great idea for them although i didnt understand a word of farsi i understood that the lines of twenty iranian students had split and my entry into the building caused a fearful and chaotic commotion my passport was taken for two hours during a body search and i didnt know if i would ever be allowed to leave the building i finally got my passport back and was allowed to leave the house but i didnt get a single interview statement about the islamic revolution in iran however i understood concretely how estebdad or authoritarian rule and the change of power meant in practice a deep fear of destroying the previous power network soon hangings torture and and boiling oil drinking parties began in iran which i wrote about in the then uusi suomi and its afternoon edition iltalehti founded in 1980 in reality the shahs regime was a brutal kleptocratic dictatorship and iranians shed blood to overthrow it the pretense that his son living in exile who has no connection to iranian reality could be a democratic alternative offends every thinking iranian and why not every thinking westerner as well netanyahus calculation may be wrong however iranians have already risen up against the shah in bloodshed and the memory of the torture chambers of the shahs imperial iranian intelligence and security organization savak has not faded from the older generation the young on the other hand talk about civil rights and do not long for an enlightened autocrat with a golden crown a sable collar on his cloak but a political program full of hollowness reza pahlavi who scolds washington by assuring that he will not seek power sounds to many tehranis like all the other prophets of freedom in the diaspora wellintentioned but rootless and empty is iran ready for the return of the king there is no reliable gallup data on iran but diaspora surveys give pahlavi weak support at best the sins of the shah father republican identity and nationalist pride form a thick wall against monarchist dreams the return of the crown would appear to many iranians as a humiliationan admission that the country was unable to build its own indigenous system iran is not an internally stable persiaa name given by the ancient greeksbut an alliance and mosaic of numerous ethnic groups persians make up about half of irans 90 million population but azeris seek support from baku azerbaijan kurds from erbil in iraqi kurdistan arabs from khuzestan dream of autonomy for alahwaz and the baluchis look to pakistan if the central leadership in tehran collapses each periphery will see its opportunity and the middle east could see its yugoslavian moment government artillery separatist militias and external allies firing at each other in the crossfire of civil war israel has been attacking irans nuclear infrastructure through kurdistan for years the threat is that after a change of power the isfahan arak and natanz nuclear facilities could fall into the hands of local clan commanders azeri militants could sell lowenrichment material on the gray market and washington would have to set up an organization similar to the isg the iraqi inspection group the price tag for the united states would again be in the tens of billions which does not fit trumps dealmaking thinking according to which even armed support for allies is always subject to consideration not politically but economically pure dry money a fifth of the worlds seaborne oil is squeezed into the 39kilometerwide strait of hormuz if state control in iran disappears a nightmare in the strait of hormuz is a foregone conclusion irans revolutionary guard could disintegrate into selfstyled pirateridden corsair fleets or local emirates could rise up on the coast inviting saudi and emirati forces to join them either scenario would spook the oil market and force the united states into crisis management even if it does not officially take ownership of the operation the dictionary of diplomacy offers the term integration wto membership imf program regional free trade etc in irans case however it is a question of three locks the revolutionary guards dna the financial logic of oil dependence and the militant rebel groups of an ethnic mosaic if even one of these parts fails the entire western plan led by netanyahu will fall apart the question in washington is increasingly whether to aim for a tamed iran or a managed disintegration the latter is morally timid but some believe it is the most realistic the voices are the same as those who were wrong about iraq and libya those who were right are once again on the sidelines israel can push the first domino but it cannot decide in which order the pieces will eventually fall if netanyahu is wrong and the signs point to that washington will once again find itself cleaning up israels emergency surgery room the chaos in hormuz and the uncontrolled spread of nuclear material could lead to an even messier situation in the middle east under netanyahus vision just when we thought the situation couldnt get any messier than it is now yes it can text by eeropekka rislakki
